podcast.title: Co-development of the First Speaker
podcast.body: AT&T was involved in a co-development project with General Electric in 1921, which successfully produced the first speaker. This device, featuring a paper coil, was a foundational invention for sound reproduction from electrical signals. "And that happened in 1921, when a co-development project between General Electric and AT&T resulted in the first speaker, a paper call that reproduced sound."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Story of the Electric Guitar - Part 1

podcast.title: Transistor Invention and Licensing
podcast.body: AT&T was the original inventor of the transistor technology. The company licensed this groundbreaking technology to other companies, which enabled its widespread adoption and the development of portable electronic devices like transistor radios. `"AT&T, the inventor of the transistor, was licensing the technology to other companies."`
